htmlScriptDocument:
DRAFT 1

The Quiet Scientist

A quiet kid in sunglasses grows into old cars, first jobs and steady love — a warm comedy about saying little and meaning it.

Shape Bar — 60s total

Part 1: Original 30s
Part 2: Sequel 30s

Part 1: Original 30s | Part 2: Sequel 30s | Total 60s | 13 shots

How to Read This

SHOT 1 | 0-4s = shot number and time in seconds. Where we are appears only when the place changes. What we see is plain visual action. What we hear appears when there is music or quiet with no talking. Dialogue looks like @Mom: {My line.}. Director's Note warns what breaks if you get it wrong.

Cast

Shaz, 8, dreamer (@Shaz)

Accent: oversized black sunglasses worn in every indoor scene | Voice: 8-year-old American boy, soft low volume, flat steady tone, slow careful pace, short declarative sentences with long pauses | Skin: warm medium brown

Part 1: Original | 0-30s

SHOT 1 | 0-4s

Where we are: Living room, daytime

What we see: Warm living room with a small TV showing a card battle cartoon. Eight-year-old Shaz with warm medium brown skin sits center on the couch wearing oversized black sunglasses, breathing quietly and blinking with head down. Older sister age 18 with warm medium brown skin in teal hijab fully covering hair with no visible hair sits left, little brother age 6 with warm medium brown skin sits right holding cards, all watching.

@Shaz_Adult: {When I was eight, I barely talked at all.}

Director's Note: Play this completely ordinary — if the room feels special, the later payoff has nothing to stand out against.

SHOT 2 | 4-8s

What we see: Shaz with warm medium brown skin lifts his chin from under the oversized sunglasses, chest rising and falling as he breathes, and sits upright in one clear pose. Mom with warm medium brown skin in dusty rose hijab fully covering hair with no visible hair leans in from the kitchen doorway, hands still, watching him and breathing calmly.

@Shaz: {I want to be a scientist.}

Director's Note: Hold his small upright pose with no big gestures — if he acts big, his quiet ladder breaks.

SHOT 3 | 8-11s

What we see: Mom with warm medium brown skin in dusty rose hijab fully covering hair with no visible hair claps both hands once, shoulders lifting as she breathes and smiles. Shaz with warm medium brown skin stays seated behind sunglasses, blinking, chest moving with breath.

@Mom: {My scientist! So proud of you!}

SHOT 4 | 11-15s

What we see: On the carpet, little brother age 6 with warm medium brown skin and big sister age 18 with warm medium brown skin in teal hijab fully covering hair with no visible hair kneel facing each other, breathing and shifting weight, placing Yugioh cards down. Shaz with warm medium brown skin watches from the couch edge with sunglasses on, legs swinging slightly as he breathes.

@Shaz_Adult: {We watched Yu-Gi-Oh GX together. Every battle counted.}

SHOT 5 | 15-19s

Where we are: Outside a faded old coupe, daytime

What we see: A faded coupe with dull paint parked at the curb with windows down. Teen Shaz age 18 with warm medium brown skin stands by the open driver door, breathing steadily, hand resting on the roof, looking at the car with steady eyes.

@Shaz_Adult: {My first freedom was my old Honda with no A-C.}

SHOT 6 | 19-24s

What we see: Inside the coupe, Teen Shaz age 18 with warm medium brown skin sits in the driver seat, plugging a black aux cable into the radio, chest rising as he breathes, eyes steady on the dial.

What we hear: Warm guitar riff from car speakers, soft engine hum.

@Shaz_Teen: {I wired the aux myself. Play your tunes.}

SHOT 7 | 24-30s | Continuous camera move

What we see: From the side of the sunny street, the faded coupe rolls slowly forward with windows down. Teen Shaz age 18 with warm medium brown skin holds the wheel with both hands, breathing calmly, hair shifting in the wind, eyes forward.

@Shaz_Adult: {It was mine, and that meant everything.}

Director's Note: End on forward motion only — if you stop the car early, Part 2 job payoff starts flat.

Part 2: Sequel | 0-30s

SHOT 1 | 0-4s

Where we are: Small desk at home, evening

What we see: Adult Shaz age 19 with warm medium brown skin sits at a small desk with a silver laptop open, breathing steadily and blinking, fingers pausing over the keys. A soft lamp glows behind on a plain wall.

@Shaz_Adult: {I doubled up, graduated early, and learned to code.}

SHOT 2 | 4-9s

What we see: Adult Shaz age 19 with warm medium brown skin stands in the modest living room holding the laptop to his chest, breathing with lift, body upright in one clear pose. Mom with warm medium brown skin in dusty rose hijab fully covering hair with no visible hair stands nearby with hands clasped, breathing and watching.

@Shaz_Adult: {I got the job! I'm nineteen!}
Narration @Shaz_Adult: {Fifty K at home felt like six figures.}

SHOT 3 | 9-14s

Where we are: Living room couch, night, phone glow

What we see: Adult Shaz age 19 with warm medium brown skin sits on the couch edge at night, breathing slowly, holding a phone with both hands, eyes on the screen, blinking in the glow.

@Shaz_Adult: {We met far apart, Dallas to Chicago, once a week.}

SHOT 4 | 14-19s

What we see: The phone screen shows Wife with warm medium brown skin in soft sage hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair, no hairline and no dark band at forehead, breathing calmly and blinking with a soft smile. The thumb of Adult Shaz with warm medium brown skin holds the edge steady.

@Wife: {It's eight. I'm here.}

Director's Note: Play her arrival completely steady — if she acts surprised, the consistency love story loses its meaning.

SHOT 5 | 19-25s

What we see: Adult Shaz age 19 with warm medium brown skin rests back on the couch, breathing slow, shoulders lowering in one clear relaxed pose, eyes soft on the phone. Wife with warm medium brown skin in soft sage hijab fully covering hair with no visible hair stays small on the screen, breathing and listening.

@Shaz_Adult: {She never rushed me, so I wanted to lean closer.}

SHOT 6 | 25-30s | Continuous camera move

What we see: Adult Shaz age 19 with warm medium brown skin sits upright with hands resting still in his lap, breathing calmly with slight chest rise, eyes forward with honest gaze. Gentle daylight fills the room.

@Shaz_Adult: {Mia, I love you. Think good things and love grows.}

Director's Note: Keep this tender and still with no joke — if you push funny here, the whole letter to Mia breaks.

Draft 1 | 13 shots | 60s total | End.
